description: Review-sidecar — reviewer verdict artifact, historically colocated with plans at docs/plans/*.review.md, relocated to state/plan-sidecars/*.review.md by the docs/plans/2026-07-24-g2-plan-pipeline-sidecar-contract.md C11 non-plan-sidecar sweep (rename-on-existing preserved, git-log-followable). New named-reviewer dispatches persist to the DR-091 session-keyed state/subagent-share/<session>/<provision_key>.md home instead (reviewer-pipeline.md), covered by the universal run-report superset schema, not this applies_to glob — this schema now enumerates the archived legacy corpus. kinds list: role-based canonical values first, then legacy disk-census values retained as resolvers.

plan.description: Repo-relative path to the plan this sidecar reviewed.

reviewer.description: Role slug for the reviewer, matching the agent-registry slug (e.g. staff-eng, code-reviewer). Not a persona name — persona names are human-facing display aliases only.

created.description: Date the review sidecar was authored (YYYY-MM-DD).

title.description: Human-readable label for the review sidecar.

findings_count.description: Total number of findings in this review.

diff_sha.description: Git SHA the review diff was taken at.

predecessor_review.description: Path to the predecessor review sidecar (for rereview iteration).

prior_art_check.description: Path to the prior-art-check sidecar consumed alongside this review.
